abstract: Using the polymerase chain reaction and single-strand conformation polymorphism analysis, p53 gene mutations were examined in 24 cases of ovarian tumor including 14 ovarian carcinomas and 2 borderline cases of common epithelial type, 7 germ cell tumors, and one stromal tumor. Abnormal bands indicating mutations were detected in 12 (50%) of the cases examined, being present most frequently in common "epithelial" ovarian carcinoma (71%, 10/14). One case each of squamous cell carcinoma originating in a dermoid cyst and anaplastic dysgerminoma were positive for mutation. Direct sequencing confirmed 12 mutations and revealed G-->A and G-->C nucleotide changes in 5 and 3 cases (42% and 25%), respectively. The mutation was localized at the CpG site of the gene in 3 cases. Immunohistochemical examination of p53 protein in 21 cases and DNA flow-cytometrical analysis in 17 cases were also performed. Nuclear accumulation of the p53 protein and DNA aneuploidy pattern were detected in 11 (52%) and 9 (53%) cases, respectively. These were significantly correlated with p53 gene mutation (P < 0.01 and P < 0.05, respectively; Fisher's exact test). Neither mutation of the p53 gene, nuclear accumulation of p53 protein nor DNA aneuploidy was detected in borderline cases of common "epithelial" type, typical dysgerminoma and immature teratoma. These results suggest that p53 gene mutation, nuclear accumulation of the protein and the DNA aneuploidy pattern are events occurring almost simultaneously in the progression of ovarian tumors, and that p53 abnormalities seem to be correlated with a high grade of malignancy.
abstract_ja: ポリメラーゼ連鎖反応と一本鎖立体構造多型(SSCP)解析を用いて、卵巣腫瘍24例（上皮性卵巣癌14例と境界悪性2例、胚細胞腫瘍7例、間質性腫瘍1例）におけるp53遺伝子変異を検討した。変異を示す異常バンドは、24例中12例(50%)で検出され、最も高頻度だったのは上皮性卵巣癌(71%、14例中10例)であった。直接塩基配列決定により12例の変異が確認され、G→A変換が5例(42%)、G→C変換が3例(25%)に認められた。変異がCpG部位に局在していた症例が3例あった。21例でp53蛋白の免疫組織化学検査、17例でDNAフローサイトメトリー解析を行った。p53蛋白の核内蓄積とDNA異数性パターンは、それぞれ11例(52%)と9例(53%)で検出された。これらはp53遺伝子変異と有意に相関していた（それぞれP<0.01、P<0.05、Fisher直接確率検定）。p53遺伝子変異、p53蛋白の核内蓄積、DNA異数性のいずれも、上皮性境界悪性例、典型的なディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、未熟奇形腫では検出されなかった。これらの結果は、p53遺伝子変異、蛋白の核内蓄積、DNA異数性パターンが卵巣腫瘍の進展においてほぼ同時に生じる事象であり、p53異常は高悪性度と関連している可能性を示唆する。
